name: Vigilante Twin Soul
body:
Your social identity and vigilante identity aren’t just different personalities—they are entirely different people!

Twin Souls (Ex)

When you switch from one identity to another, you magically transform from one body to the other. Both of your bodies share the same class levels, feats, and other choices except as described here.

At first level, make the decisions for your species, gender, age, alignment, ability scores, and skill ranks separately for your social and vigilante identities. Continue to track any choices you make considering these elements of your character separately, including any skill ranks and ability score bonuses you gain as you increase in level.

As with a standard vigilante, your two alignments cannot be more than one step from each other on a single alignment axis.

Additionally, your two identities must be within one size category of each other. Any equipment magically resizes when you transform, and magic items remain attuned to you.

If you have a feat or ability in one identity that you do not have in your other identity, you also lose access to any other feats or abilities for which it is a prerequisite. For example, if you choose Dodge with your human bonus feat in your social identity, you would not only lose that feat when you change to your vigilante identity as an elf but would also lose Mobility if you had subsequently chosen it, since Dodge is a prerequisite for Mobility. (Keep in mind that if your social identity is human and your vigilante identity is not, then your vigilante identity loses both your human bonus feat and all of your bonus human skill ranks.)

If you select a feat or talent with a prerequisite, it only functions when you are in an identity where you would qualify for that feat. Unless otherwise stated, your social identity counts as your identity for the purpose of all social talents (including many guises and any talents with many guises as a prerequisite), and your vigilante identity counts as your identity for all vigilante talents.

This feature alters dual identity and replaces vigilante specialization.

Character Options: The Vigilante. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum.
